subject: general
question: A person marks the price of his car 50% above the cost price. He gives a discount of B% and earns a profit of 10%. What is the approximate value of B?
solution:
Given:

A person marks the price of his car 50% above the cost price. 

He gives a discount of B% and earns a profit of 10%.

Concept used:

Final percentage change after two successive increments of A% and B% = (A + B + {AB over 100})\%

Calculation:

According to the concept,

50 - B - (50B)/100 = 10 (Here, B% discount is considered as a negative mark-up/increment)

⇒ 50 - B - B/2 = 10

⇒ 3B/2 = 40

⇒ B = 80/3

⇒ B ≈ 26.67

∴ The approximate value of B is 26.67.
